system.name: Oryx
system.one_liner: Unified multimodal LLM that encodes images, videos and multi-view 3D scenes at native resolution and compresses visual tokens on request.

content.variant_note: four tinted case cards flank a central model emblem; each card pairs a takeaway tab, a user/model dialogue, a real input with its size or duration, and a row of token boxes with the exact count
content.argues: Different visual data and tasks need different input resolutions and token compression, so an MLLM should support arbitrary resolution and compression on demand.
content.subject: Four tinted case cards with dialogues, input sizes and token counts around the Oryx emblem.

lessons.what_to_learn: State a trade-off with one card per setting: repeat one card grammar (tab with the takeaway, task title, user/model dialogue, input picture with its size or duration arrow, row of token boxes with the exact count) four times, one hue each, around the model's emblem.
lessons.suits: Motivation figures for methods that adapt compute or token budgets to the input, where each setting needs a real example and its cost side by side.

evidence: Different visual data and tasks may require different input resolutions and compression ratios on visual tokens.
high resolution is crucial for text-relevant tasks, while object-level tasks may require only simple images
a dynamic compressor module that supports 1x to 16x compression on visual tokens by request

summary: Oryx is a multimodal LLM that encodes images, videos and multi-view 3D scenes at their native resolution and compresses visual tokens on request. Figure 1 states the idea with four tinted case cards on either side of the Oryx emblem. Each card has a tab with its takeaway, a user question with Oryx's answer, the input (a newspaper page, a panda photo, tennis frames, a documentary) with pixel-size or duration arrows, and a row of token boxes with the exact count: native resolution for text retrieval (6144 tokens), low resolution for objects (1584), low compression for frame localisation (225 per frame) and high compression for long videos (20 per frame). Captions under the two columns name on-demand resolution and on-demand compression.
summary_zh: Oryx 能按需选择视觉输入的分辨率和令牌压缩比。图 1 在 Oryx 标志两侧放四张彩色案例卡：文字检索、物体识别、帧定位、长视频摘要，每张含问答、输入尺寸或时长箭头和令牌数方框，说明不同任务需要不同的分辨率与压缩。
notes: Kept the prior pass's two kinds and added concept-schematic (phenomenon-on-examples): the idea of on-demand resolution and compression is shown only through example cards while the model is a logo. The tab on card 1 reads 'Preseves' in the figure. The palette roles of #eef9ff, #edf9f5, #f7f2fc and #f9efe5 are inferred from hue (dialogue-box fills). The Oryx emblem's origin is guessed from its look.
